author: reek
body: Waveform display data model for simulation results. Stores time-domain waveforms with measurement cursors and provides analysis functions including interpolation, peak detection, and RMS calculation.

author: reek
body: Linear interpolation to find waveform value at an arbitrary time. Scans adjacent point pairs and interpolates between the bracketing pair. Returns 0.0 if the waveform has fewer than two points or if the time is outside the sampled range.

author: reek
body: Root mean square of all sampled points. Computes the square root of the mean of squared values using Newton's method for the square root.
